question: My sister ____ to school by bus every morning.
explanation: every morning 表示習慣，主詞 My sister 是第三人稱單數，動詞加 s 用 goes；went 是過去式，不合習慣用法。

question: Mei and her brother ____ basketball after school on Fridays.
explanation: on Fridays 表示每週的習慣，主詞 Mei and her brother 是複數，用原形 play；plays 只用在第三人稱單數。

question: Kevin ____ a new bike from the store last Sunday.
explanation: last Sunday 表示過去，動詞用過去式 bought；will buy 是未來式，和 last 不合。

question:
A: Where were you two days ago?
B: I ____ at my grandma's house.
explanation: two days ago 表示過去，主詞 I 的 be 動詞過去式是 was；were 用於 you、we、they 或複數主詞。

question: Look! The children ____ in the park now.
explanation: Look! 和 now 表示正在發生，用現在進行式 are running；run 是現在簡單式，表示習慣而非正在進行。

question:
A: What were you doing at nine last night?
B: I ____ a letter in my room.
explanation: 問句 What were you doing 和 at nine last night 表示過去某時正在做的事，用過去進行式 was writing；am writing 是現在進行式。

question: Be quiet, please. The baby ____ now.
explanation: now 表示此刻正在發生，用現在進行式 is sleeping；sleeps 表示習慣，不合 now。

question: We ____ a picnic at the beach next weekend.
explanation: next weekend 表示未來，用未來式 will have；had 是過去式，和 next 不合。

question: Jason ____ his uncle tomorrow afternoon.
explanation: tomorrow afternoon 表示未來，用 be going to + 原形動詞 is going to visit；visited 是過去式。

question:
A: Will you come to my birthday party on Saturday?
B: Yes, I ____.
explanation: 問句用 Will you ...? 詢問未來，肯定簡答用 Yes, I will.；do 用來回答 Do you ...? 的問句。

question: It's raining hard. You should ____ an umbrella with you.
explanation: 助動詞 should 後面接原形動詞，所以用 take；takes、took 都不能放在助動詞後面。

question: ____ your father speak English?
explanation: 主詞 your father 是第三人稱單數，句中動詞 speak 是原形，問句要用助動詞 Does；Is 後面不接原形動詞。

question: Ben ____ swim when he was five, but now he swims very well.
explanation: when he was five 表示過去，can 的過去式否定是 couldn't；can't 是現在式，和過去時間不合。

question: Lisa can't find her pencil box. I have it, so I will give it to ____ later.
explanation: 介系詞 to 後面要用受詞，she 的受格是 her；she 是主格，不能放在介系詞後面。

question:
A: Are these shoes yours, Tina?
B: No, they're not ____. They're my sister's.
explanation: 句子後面沒有名詞，要用所有格代名詞 mine（我的東西）；my 後面一定要接名詞。

question: Kevin and I are good friends. ____ often study together.
explanation: Kevin and I 當主詞，要用主格 We；Us 是受格，不能當主詞。

question: My bag is ____ than yours. It has many books in it.
explanation: than 表示兩者比較，用比較級 heavier（y 改 i 加 er）；more heavy 是錯誤形式。

question: Sam is the ____ boy in our class.
explanation: the 加上 in our class 表示三者以上中最…，用最高級 tallest；taller 是比較級，要搭配 than。

question: Riding a bike is ____ than walking.
explanation: than 是比較的線索，用比較級 faster；fastest 是最高級，不和 than 一起用。

question: My birthday is ____ May.
explanation: 月份前面用介系詞 in，所以是 in May；on 要用在特定日期，例如 on May 5。

question: The movie starts ____ seven o'clock tonight.
explanation: 時刻（seven o'clock）前面用 at；in 用在月份、年份或早上、下午等較長的時間。

question: I eat ____ apple every day.
explanation: apple 是單數名詞且開頭是母音發音，冠詞用 an；a 用在子音開頭的字前面。

question: There are three ____ on the table.
explanation: three 和 There are 表示複數，名詞要用複數形 boxes（字尾 x 加 es）；box 是單數。

question: We ____ to the beach with our family last summer.
explanation: last summer 表示過去，動詞用過去式 went；will go 是未來式，和 last 不合。

question: Mr. Lin ____ coffee. He only drinks tea.
explanation: 後句 He only drinks tea 用現在簡單式，主詞 Mr. Lin 是第三人稱單數，否定用 doesn't drink；don't 用於複數或 I、you。

question: My brother ____ in Tainan since 2020.
explanation: since 2020 表示從過去持續到現在，要用現在完成式 has lived。lived 只說過去，無法和 since 連用。

question:
A: Have you been to Japan yet?
B: No, I ____ there yet.
explanation: 問句用 Have you been … yet，回答也要用現在完成式 haven't been，表示「到現在還沒去過」。didn't go 是過去式，不能搭配 yet。

question: Amy and I ____ each other for ten years, and we are still good friends.
explanation: for ten years 表示持續到現在的一段時間，用現在完成式 have known。know 是狀態動詞，不用進行式 are knowing。

question: This old temple ____ more than two hundred years ago.
explanation: 廟是「被建造」，要用被動語態；ago 表示過去，所以用 was built。is built 是現在式，時態不合。

question: English ____ in many countries around the world.
explanation: 英語是「被說」的，用被動語態 be + p.p.，敘述一般事實用現在式 is spoken。speaks 是主動，表示英語自己會說話，不合理。

question: It ____ me two hours to finish the puzzle yesterday.
explanation: 「It takes + 人 + 時間 + to V」表示花多少時間做某事，yesterday 用過去式 took。spent 的主詞要是人（I spent two hours…），不能用 It。

question: The girl ____ is singing on the stage is my cousin.
explanation: 先行詞 the girl 是人，關係子句缺主詞，用 who。which 用於事物，whose 後面要接名詞。

question: I have a friend ____ father is a famous cook.
explanation: 空格後接名詞 father，表示「朋友的爸爸」，要用所有格關係代名詞 whose。who 和 that 後面不能直接接名詞當所有格。

question: The book ____ you lent me last week was very interesting.
explanation: 先行詞 the book 是事物，關係子句缺受詞，用 which。what 本身已含先行詞，前面有 the book 就不能再用。

question: Your sister can't swim, ____?
explanation: 前句是否定的 can't，附加問句要用肯定的 can she。前句有助動詞 can，不用 does。

question: Ben went to the party last night, ____?
explanation: 前句是肯定的過去式 went，附加問句用否定的 didn't he。did he 是肯定，和前句同為肯定，不正確。

question:
A: You've finished your science report, ____?
B: Yes, I gave it to Ms. Wang this morning.
explanation: You've 是 You have，前句肯定、助動詞是 have，附加問句用 haven't you。didn't you 是給過去式動詞用的。

question: My father decided ____ smoking because it is bad for his health.
explanation: decide 後面接不定詞 to V，所以用 to stop。stopping 是動名詞，不能接在 decide 後面。

question: Kevin is good at ____ pictures of animals.
explanation: at 是介系詞，後面的動詞要用動名詞 drawing。to draw 是不定詞，不能接在介系詞後面。

question: ____ it rained hard, the baseball game didn't stop.
explanation: 雨下很大但比賽沒停，前後是相反的關係，用 Although（雖然）。Because 表示原因，意思不通。

question: You will miss the bus ____ you get up right now.
explanation: 「除非你現在起床，否則會錯過公車」，用 unless（除非）。if 會變成「如果現在起床就會錯過公車」，意思相反。

question: The soup was ____ hot that I couldn't drink it.
explanation: 句中有 that，是 so + 形容詞 + that（如此…以致於）的句型，用 so。such 後面要接名詞，too 不和 that 搭配。

question: Do you know where ____?
explanation: 間接問句要用直述句語序「疑問詞 + 主詞 + 動詞」，所以是 where she lives。does she live 是直接問句的語序。

question:
A: Can you tell me ____?
B: It starts at seven.
explanation: 間接問句用直述句語序，B 回答 It starts 是現在式，所以選 when the movie starts。when the movie started 語序對，但時態是過去式，和回答不合。

question: Mom made me ____ my room before I went out.
explanation: 使役動詞 make 的句型是 make + 人 + 原形動詞，所以用 clean。to clean 是常見錯誤，make 後面不加 to。

question: I heard someone ____ my name when I was walking in the park.
explanation: 感官動詞 hear 的句型是 hear + 人 + 原形動詞（或 V-ing），選項中只有 call 正確。called 表示被動，是「某人被叫」，意思不對。

question: When the phone rang, I ____ a shower.
explanation: 電話響（rang）時，洗澡這個動作正在進行，用過去進行式 was taking。am taking 是現在進行式，和過去的 rang 時態不合。

question:
A: What was your brother doing when you got home?
B: He ____ TV in the living room.
explanation: 問句 What was your brother doing when you got home 問過去某個時間點正在做的事，回答用過去進行式 was watching。is watching 是現在進行式，時間不對。

question: The box is ____ heavy for me to carry.
explanation: too + 形容詞 + for 人 + to V 表示「太…而不能…」，所以用 too。so 要搭配 that 子句，不接 to V。

question: Is your brother old ____ to drive a car?
explanation: 形容詞 + enough + to V 表示「夠…可以…」，enough 放在形容詞 old 後面。too 要放在形容詞前面，位置不對。

question: It's very cold outside. ____ your jacket before you go out.
explanation: put on 是「穿上」。線索是 It's very cold outside（外面很冷），出門前要穿上夾克。take off 脫下、turn off 關掉、throw away 丟掉。

question: The baby is sleeping. Please don't ____ so loudly.
explanation: shout 是「大叫」。線索是 The baby is sleeping（寶寶在睡覺）和 loudly（大聲地），所以請別大聲叫。sit 坐、write 寫、wait 等待。

question: I can't find my glasses. Can you help me ____ them?
explanation: look for 是「尋找」。線索是 I can't find my glasses（找不到眼鏡），所以請人幫忙找。put on 戴上、take off 脫下、turn on 打開（電器）。

question: Ken got a hundred on the math test, so he was very ____.
explanation: happy 是「高興的」。線索是 got a hundred（考一百分），所以很高興。angry 生氣的、sad 難過的、sick 生病的。

question: Please ____ the window. It's too hot in this room.
explanation: open 是「打開」。線索是 It's too hot in this room（房間太熱），所以要打開窗戶。close 關上、wash 洗、paint 油漆。

question: Linda ____ eats breakfast. She has it at home every morning.
explanation: always 是「總是」。線索是第二句 every morning（每天早上），所以她總是吃早餐。never 從不、sometimes 有時候、seldom 很少，都和 every morning 矛盾。

question: Please pass me the ____. I want to cut the cake.
explanation: knife 是「刀子」。線索是第二句 I want to cut the cake（我想切蛋糕），切東西要用刀子。spoon 湯匙、chair 椅子、phone 電話。

question: My little brother is afraid of ____ rooms, so he always keeps the light on.
explanation: dark 是「黑暗的」。線索是 keeps the light on（一直開著燈），所以他怕黑暗的房間。big 大的、clean 乾淨的、warm 溫暖的。

question: Please be ____ in the library. Many people are reading there.
explanation: quiet 是「安靜的」。線索是 Many people are reading（很多人在看書），所以在圖書館要保持安靜。loud 大聲的、hungry 餓的、late 遲到的。

question: Jenny ____ her little sister when her parents are at work. She cooks dinner for her and helps her with her homework.
explanation: take care of 是「照顧」。線索是第二句 cooks dinner for her and helps her with her homework（煮晚餐、幫忙寫功課），表示她在照顧妹妹。look for 尋找、laugh at 嘲笑、throw away 丟掉。

question: Peter practiced the piano every day, so he played very ____ at the school party.
explanation: well 是「好地、出色地」。線索是 practiced the piano every day（每天練琴），所以在學校派對上彈得很好。badly 差勁地、slowly 緩慢地、sadly 難過地。

question: It's raining hard outside. Don't forget to take your ____ with you.
explanation: umbrella 是「雨傘」。線索是 It's raining hard（外面雨下很大），所以要帶雨傘。ticket 票、sandwich 三明治、eraser 橡皮擦。

question: Mia ____ her bike to school every day because it's only ten minutes away.
explanation: rides 是「騎」。ride a bike to school 是「騎腳踏車上學」；線索是 to school every day（每天去學校）。drinks 喝、cleans 清潔、sells 賣。

question: The night market is very ____ on weekends. There are always lots of people there.
explanation: busy 是「熱鬧的、繁忙的」。線索是 lots of people（很多人），所以週末夜市很熱鬧。quiet 安靜的、cheap 便宜的、dark 黑暗的。

question: The ____ is very hot today. Let's go swimming in the sea.
explanation: weather 是「天氣」。線索是 very hot today 和 go swimming（今天很熱、去游泳），說的是天氣。homework 功課、music 音樂、money 錢。

question: Kevin was very tired last night, so he ____ to bed early.
explanation: go to bed 是「上床睡覺」，went 是 go 的過去式。線索是 was very tired（很累），所以很早就去睡了。sang 唱歌、cooked 煮飯、shouted 大叫，都不能接 to bed。

question: The bus will leave in two minutes. We have to walk ____.
explanation: quickly 是「快速地」。線索是 The bus will leave in two minutes（公車兩分鐘後就開走），所以要走快一點。slowly 慢慢地、sadly 難過地、kindly 親切地。

question: This bag is too ____ for me. I can't lift it.
explanation: heavy 是「重的」。線索是 I can't lift it（我提不起來），所以袋子太重。cheap 便宜的、new 新的、clean 乾淨的。

question: Amy has a bad cold, so her mother is taking her to see a ____.
explanation: doctor 是「醫生」。線索是 has a bad cold（重感冒），所以媽媽帶她去看醫生。farmer 農夫、driver 司機、singer 歌手。

question: Can you ____ me with this heavy box? I can't carry it alone.
explanation: help 是「幫忙」，help sb. with sth. 是「幫某人做某事」。線索是 I can't carry it alone（我一個人搬不動）。see 看見、hear 聽見、find 找到。

question: I ____ my wallet on the bus yesterday, so I had no money for lunch.
explanation: lost 是 lose（遺失）的過去式。線索是結果 so I had no money for lunch（沒錢吃午餐），所以是把錢包弄丟了。bought 買、found 找到、washed 洗。

question: Ben loves animals. He wants to work at the ____ when he grows up.
explanation: zoo 是「動物園」。線索是 Ben loves animals（喜歡動物），所以長大想在動物園工作。bank 銀行、library 圖書館、bookstore 書店。

question: I can't open the door because I lost my ____.
explanation: key 是「鑰匙」。線索是 can't open the door（打不開門），原因是弄丟了鑰匙。map 地圖、ball 球、cake 蛋糕。

question: The tea is too ____. Let's wait a few minutes before we drink it.
explanation: hot 是「燙的、熱的」。線索是 wait a few minutes before we drink it（等幾分鐘再喝），表示茶太燙。cold 冷的、sweet 甜的、short 短的。

question: When I was little, Grandma ____ me a story every night before I went to sleep.
explanation: told 是 tell（講述）的過去式，tell sb. a story 是「講故事給某人聽」。線索是 story 和 before I went to sleep（睡前）。cleaned 清潔、cut 切、built 建造。

question: My little brother is afraid of the dark, so he always sleeps with the ____ on.
explanation: light 是「燈」。線索是 afraid of the dark（怕黑），所以睡覺時要開著燈（with the light on）；窗戶、地板、桌子都不能「開著」。

question: I need to buy some stamps and send this letter to my aunt. Let's go to the ____.
explanation: post office 是「郵局」。線索是 buy some stamps（買郵票）和 send this letter（寄信），這些事要在郵局做。

question: Can you tell me the ____ of this word? I can't find it in my dictionary.
explanation: meaning 是「意思」。線索是 this word 和 dictionary（字典）：查字典是為了知道字的意思；天氣、價錢、顏色都和單字無關。

question: Peter forgot his ____ this morning, so he couldn't get into his house after school.
explanation: key 是「鑰匙」。線索是 couldn't get into his house（進不了家門），因為忘了帶鑰匙；雨傘、票、地圖都不會讓人進不了家。

question: Jenny ____ her umbrella on the bus, so she got wet on her way home.
explanation: left 是 leave 的過去式，leave something 在這裡指「把東西遺忘在某處」。線索是 got wet（淋濕了）：傘忘在公車上，所以回家路上淋濕；如果找到、買了或帶著傘就不會淋濕。

question: Mark ____ the race and got a gold medal.
explanation: won 是 win 的過去式，意思是「贏得」。線索是 got a gold medal（得到金牌），所以他贏了比賽；輸了、錯過或只是觀看比賽都不會得到金牌。

question: Could you ____ me your pen? I'll give it back to you after class.
explanation: lend 是「借給（別人）」，lend me your pen＝把筆借給我。線索是 I'll give it back（我會還你）。borrow 是「向別人借入」，不能說 borrow me；sell（賣）、show（給…看）都不需要歸還。

question: Mom ____ the cake into eight pieces, so everyone at the party could have one.
explanation: cut 是「切」（過去式同形）。線索是 into eight pieces（切成八塊），讓每個人都能分到一塊；cook、wash、drop 都不能把蛋糕分成八塊給大家吃。

question: I couldn't ____ what the teacher said because the students behind me were too noisy.
explanation: hear 是「聽見」。線索是 the students behind me were too noisy（後面的同學太吵），所以聽不清楚老師說的話。

question: This cake is too ____. I think you put too much sugar in it.
explanation: sweet 是「甜的」。線索是 too much sugar（放了太多糖），蛋糕當然太甜；hot（燙）、cold（冷）、sour（酸）都和糖無關。

question: Lisa felt very ____ after she ran ten kilometers, so she went to bed early that night.
explanation: tired 是「疲累的」。線索是 ran ten kilometers（跑了十公里）和 went to bed early（早早上床睡覺），可見她很累。

question: This box is too ____. I can't carry it by myself. Can you help me?
explanation: heavy 是「重的」。線索是 I can't carry it by myself（我一個人搬不動），表示箱子太重；cheap（便宜）、empty（空的）、soft（軟的）都不會讓人搬不動。

question: Be ____ when you use this knife. It's very sharp.
explanation: careful 是「小心的」。線索是 It's very sharp（刀子很鋒利），所以使用時要小心。

question: We missed the bus, so we had to walk ____ to get to school on time.
explanation: quickly 是「快速地」。線索是 missed the bus（錯過公車）和 on time（準時）：沒搭上公車，要走快一點才能準時到校；slowly（慢慢地）正好相反。

question: Ben is a good student. He ____ forgets to do his homework.
explanation: never 是「從不」。線索是 a good student（好學生），所以他從不忘記寫作業；always、usually、often 都表示常常忘記，和好學生的意思矛盾。

question: Please talk ____. The baby is sleeping in the next room.
explanation: quietly 是「安靜地、小聲地」。線索是 The baby is sleeping（寶寶在睡覺），所以要小聲說話；loudly（大聲地）正好相反，badly（差勁地）、early（早）意思也不合。

question: We have ____ milk. Can you buy some on your way home?
explanation: run out of 是「用完」，have run out of milk＝牛奶喝完了。線索是 Can you buy some（可以買一些回來嗎），表示家裡沒有牛奶了。

question: My grandma is sick, so I have to ____ her this weekend.
explanation: take care of 是「照顧」。線索是 grandma is sick（奶奶生病了），所以要照顧她；laugh at 是「嘲笑」，get off 是「下車」，look like 是「看起來像」，意思都不合。

question: Don't ____! You can do it if you keep trying.
explanation: give up 是「放棄」。線索是 keep trying（繼續努力）和 You can do it（你做得到），所以是在鼓勵對方不要放棄。

question: I'm ____ seeing my cousins this summer. We haven't met for three years.
explanation: look forward to 是「期待」，後面接名詞或動名詞（seeing）。線索是 haven't met for three years（三年沒見面了），所以很期待見到表兄弟姊妹；good at（擅長）、afraid of（害怕）、tired of（厭倦）意思都不合。

question:
A: Thank you for helping me with my homework.
B: ____
explanation: 別人說 Thank you（謝謝）時，最自然的回答是 You're welcome.（不客氣）。Excuse me 用來引起注意或借過，I'm sorry 是道歉，Good luck 是祝好運。

question:
A: I'm going to take my math test tomorrow.
B: ____
explanation: Good luck! 是「祝你好運」。A 說明天要考數學，B 祝他好運最自然；Here you are 是遞東西給人時說的，Never mind 是「沒關係、別在意」。

question:
A: May I use your phone?
B: ____
explanation: Sure. Here you are.（當然，拿去吧）。A 請求借用手機，B 答應並把手機遞給他；其他選項是道謝、初次見面的招呼語和回答近況，都不合。

question:
A: I'm sorry I broke your cup.
B: ____ It was an old one anyway.
explanation: That's all right.（沒關係）是回應別人道歉的話。線索是 A 說 I'm sorry，B 接著說 It was an old one anyway（反正是個舊杯子），表示不介意。You're welcome 是回應道謝，不是回應道歉。

question:
A: How about going to the movies tonight?
B: ____ I have to finish my report.
explanation: Sorry, I can't.（抱歉，我不行）。線索是後面的 I have to finish my report（我得完成報告），表示 B 要拒絕邀約；Sounds great 和 I'd love to 都是接受邀約，和後句矛盾。
